verdict.rationale: Pylon documents an official Pylon MCP Server that exposes its data to MCP-capable AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor. Those tools authenticate via OAuth and can read and update issues, accounts and contacts, and the bring-your-own-agent docs name Pylon MCP as a way to connect agents. A probe confirms the dedicated MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, a detailed tool list and setup steps beyond the summary statements.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Pylon MCP Server exposes Pylon data to AI tools that support the Model Context Protocol (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor).
AI tools authenticate with your Pylon account via OAuth and can read and update issues, accounts, and contacts within the data you can see in Pylon.
Using a combination of Webhooks, API, and/or Pylon MCP, you can connect your agent to ticketing workflows in Pylon.
